labels.footprint: One working pixel spans 8×8 output pixels.
labels.units: Values are pixel levels on the 0–255 scale.

paragraph: In our Boat run at 2048×2048, the encoder's residual at 256×256 ranged from −15.2 to +17.5 pixel levels on the 0–255 scale. Bilinear resizing to 2048×2048 spreads each working-size pixel over an 8×8 block of full-size pixels, blended with its neighbors. At pixel (904, 993), counting from zero, the input value was 155 and the resized residual was +1.12. Adding the two and dropping the fraction gave a marked value of 156.
